name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name of this platform as it will appear in Homebridge logs.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval
pollInterval.description: Determine how often should device information be fetched (in milliseconds)

cmdOn.title: PS Command ON
cmdOn.description: Custom shell command or Python script execution path to wake up the PS5.

cmdOff.title: PS Command OFF
cmdOff.description: Custom shell command or Python script execution path to put the PS5 in standby.

devices.title: Consoles (optional)
devices.description: Map each console to its own PSN account(s). A console without an entry here uses the global Account ID list above.

deviceId.title: Console ID
deviceId.description: The console ID shown in the Homebridge log when it is discovered (also the accessory serial number).

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional name for this console in HomeKit.

onlyConfiguredDevices.title: Only show consoles listed above
onlyConfiguredDevices.description: Ignore any other PlayStation discovered on the network (for example a neighbour's console).

onlyWhenAwake.title: Show game only while the console is awake
onlyWhenAwake.description: Useful when the same PSN accounts are listed for several consoles: a sleeping console will show Offline instead of the game an account is playing on another console.

form.helpvalue:
⚠️ Important: If you are using custom scripts, make sure to grant them executable permissions in your terminal:
sudo chmod +x /path/to/ps_on.py
sudo chmod +x /path/to/ps_off.py

1. Login into your PlayStation account.
2. Go to get npsso value
3. Copy and paste key to PSNAWP field.
To get your account IDs, use the command client.account_id from the official PSNAWP documentation.
